Below text a cinematic original stage: three tall editorial photo panels of a warm neighborhood cafe exterior left, artisan workshop center, indie record shop right, staggered in scale with soft rounded 24px corners, slight perspective and smaller side panels. Quiet premium, human warmth, striking typography; no testimonials, no fake stats, no dashboards. Full hero fits screen with nav, headline, CTAs, image stage. Realistic, buildable website design.
